input.final_summary: FA3 forward scheduling uses 1 producer WG + 1–3 consumer WGs (128 threads each), with consumer ping-pong on named barriers 9/10 (WG1↔WG2) and intra-WG overlap of QK(i), PV(i−1), and softmax via deferred `wg_wait=-1` plus `warpgroup_wait<1/0>`. K/V use a fixed 2-stage TMA mbarrier pipeline; `RescaleOBeforeGemm` must run after QK issue and before PV when hdim>128 to avoid ptxas C7513 WGMMA serialization.
